stories.title: Indian car sales figures for October 2026
India's auto industry accelerates in October: Passenger vehicle sales hit record 5.19 lakh, two-wheelers jump 16% - SME
Tata Motors reports quarterly loss as costs rise
stories.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles reported a consolidated net loss of Rs 5,451 crore for the September quarter. While demand outpaced supply, rising commodity costs cut into margins. The company joins other manufacturers in navigating a period of fresh capacity commitments and leadership changes across the industry.

stories.title: Eicher Motors posts record Q2 revenue of ₹7,422 crore, Royal Enfield sales rise 15% - HT Auto
Tata Motors revenue hits record high in Q2
stories.summary: Tata Motors reported its highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs 20,423 crore, a 51 percent year-on-year increase. Electric vehicle volumes surged 90 percent, supported by an expansion of the Battery-as-a-Service programme. Overall passenger vehicle volumes grew 40 percent as the company refreshed its car portfolio.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland profit rises on commercial vehicle demand
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported an 8.7 percent increase in consolidated net profit to ₹891 crore for the second quarter. Revenue rose 35 percent to ₹17,030 crore, driven by a 32 percent jump in commercial vehicle volumes. Higher material costs weighed on the final profit margins.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland reports revenue growth
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported consolidated revenue of ₹17,030 crore for the quarter ended September 30, up 35.4 percent from the previous year. Profit after tax rose 8.8 percent to ₹891 crore. The company noted market share gains in trucks and light commercial vehicles despite higher provisions.

stories.title: Belrise Industries Q2 net profit rises 25% to ₹166 crore - ET Auto
TVS Srichakra Q2 FY27 profit quadruples to ₹44 crore - ET Auto
CNH to build tractor plant in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: CNH has laid the foundation for a new tractor manufacturing plant in Jewar, Uttar Pradesh. The company plans to invest Rs 2,000 crore in India by 2030 to double its annual production capacity to 1.4 lakh units. The facility is located near the upcoming Noida International Airport.

stories.title: Toyota Model Wise Sales October 2026 to Innova, Hyryder, Fortuner, Taisor, Rumion - Gaadiwaadi.com
7-Seater Car Sales October 2026 to Ertiga, Scorpio, XUV 7XO, Innova, Carens - Gaadiwaadi.com
Tata Motors reports October sales growth
stories.summary: Tata Motors sold 73,894 passenger vehicles in October 2026, a 20.87 percent increase over the previous year. The Nexon and Punch models accounted for 57.5 percent of total sales. The newly launched Aeris model contributed the largest month-on-month gain in the company lineup.

stories.title: Toyota sales decline for top models in October
stories.summary: Toyota sold 9,441 units of its Innova and Hycross models in October 2026, maintaining the top position despite a 15 percent annual decline. The HyRider followed with 7,797 units sold, representing a 33 percent drop compared to the same period last year.

stories.title: Hyundai plans three new SUVs by 2027
stories.summary: Hyundai aims to launch 26 new models in India by 2030. As part of this strategy, the company plans to introduce three new SUVs by 2027, including a CNG version of the Bayon, a next-generation Creta, and the Ioniq P electric vehicle.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki targets 50 percent market share
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki plans to capture half of the Indian passenger vehicle market by 2030. To reach this goal, the company intends to launch seven new SUVs and increase annual production capacity to 4 million units. Two new models are expected to be showcased early next year.

stories.title: Hyundai and Kia announce five new SUV launches
stories.summary: Hyundai and Kia plan to launch five new SUVs in India by 2027 to meet rising demand. The upcoming lineup includes CNG, electric, and hybrid variants such as the Bayon CNG, Ioniq P, new generation Creta, new generation Kia Sonet, and the Kia Seltos Hybrid.

stories.title: Hyundai launches mid-variant Bayon HX5
stories.summary: Hyundai has introduced the HX5 variant of the Bayon SUV, marketed as a value-for-money option. The model is priced at ₹12.44 lakh for the manual version and ₹13.84 lakh for the automatic. The Bayon recorded 3,449 units sold in October.

stories.title: JSW to launch SUV with 1,100 km range in December
stories.summary: JSW Motors will unveil its first passenger vehicle on December 3. The SUV, expected to be named Combat, is based on the Jetour T2 manufactured by China's Chery. The company claims the vehicle will offer a range of 1,100 km. Minor design adjustments are expected for the Indian market.

stories.title: Tata Motors Records Best Ever Quarterly Revenue, Sales Up 40% - Gaadiwaadi.com
Denza Z9 GT launched in India at ₹1.57 crore
stories.summary: BYD luxury brand Denza has launched the Z9 GT, a four-door fastback, at an ex-showroom price of ₹1.57 crore. The vehicle features a 122.5 kWh battery and claims a 0 to 100 km/h time of 2.7 seconds. It will be sold entirely through imports at select showrooms.

stories.title: BYD introduces Denza D9 luxury MPV in India
stories.summary: BYD has launched the Denza D9, a 7-seater MPV priced at ₹90 lakh. The company claims an NEDC-certified range of 730 km on a single charge. Bookings are currently limited to customers in Mumbai, Gurugram, and Ahmedabad, requiring a token payment of ₹10 lakh.

stories.title: Hero unveils XPulse 450 adventure bike at EICMA
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has debuted the XPulse 450, powered by a 421cc liquid-cooled engine. Developed with the Hero MotoSports Team Rally, the motorcycle is intended to compete with middleweight adventure bikes. Hero confirmed the model will reach global markets before arriving in India.

stories.title: Hero XPulse 450 and Himalayan 450 specs compared
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has entered the middleweight adventure segment with the XPulse 450, featuring a 421cc engine and adjustable KYB suspension. It competes against the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, which utilizes a 452cc Sherpa engine. Both motorcycles are marketed for highway and off-road use.

stories.title: Ducati launches Desmo450 EDX in India
stories.summary: Ducati has launched the Desmo450 EDX at ₹18.55 lakh and the 2027 Desmo450 MX Factory at ₹21.26 lakh. Both models share a 449.6cc single-cylinder engine. The EDX is built for enduro use with trail-focused tyres, while the MX Factory is designed for motocross racing.

stories.title: Royal Enfield debuts Continental GT 750
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has unveiled the Continental GT 750 at EICMA 2026. The motorcycle features a 743cc parallel-twin engine, marking the brand's highest-performance production model to date. The bike will be available in both faired and unfaired configurations with updated hardware.

stories.title: Royal Enfield reveals Himalayan 750 specifications
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has debuted the Himalayan 750, featuring a 743cc parallel-twin engine producing 54bhp and 63Nm of torque. The adventure tourer includes adjustable Showa suspension and a six-axis IMU with five riding modes. European prices are set, though an India launch date remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: Bajaj to launch adventure and electric motorcycles
stories.summary: Bajaj Auto plans to expand its motorcycle range with new adventure and electric models. The adventure bike is scheduled for a global premiere by December 2026. The company previously confirmed its first mass-market electric motorcycle is slated for release by the 2028 fiscal year.

stories.title: TVS iQube leads electric scooter sales
stories.summary: Electric scooter sales in India grew by 67.5 percent recently. The TVS iQube leads the segment with 45,320 units sold, followed by the Bajaj Chetak with 42,394 units. Other brands including Hero Vida and Ather are also competing for market share as adoption increases.

stories.title: Bajaj Chetak crosses 10 lakh sales milestone
stories.summary: Bajaj Auto has recorded over 10 lakh sales for its Chetak electric scooter since its 2020 launch. Vahan portal data confirms 10,01,135 units sold as of November 6, 2026. Bajaj is the third company to reach this sales volume in the Indian electric two-wheeler market.

stories.title: Mahindra considers electric three-wheeler IPO
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility is evaluating an initial public offering for its electric three-wheeler business within 18 months. The company stated it will only proceed if it has a clear funding requirement, noting that its parent group remains capable of financing current expansion plans.

stories.title: Electric three-wheelers transform rural transport in Zimbabwe
stories.summary: Electric three-wheelers are being used in rural Zimbabwe to transport produce and patients. Farmers report that the vehicles allow for multiple daily trips to markets, increasing efficiency compared to previous methods of walking long distances while carrying heavy loads.

stories.title: PM E-DRIVE scheme supports EV adoption
stories.summary: The PM E-DRIVE scheme, launched in September 2024 with a ₹11,900 crore outlay, aims to accelerate electric vehicle adoption and infrastructure development. As of June 2026, the program has enabled 26.59 million sales. The initiative is scheduled to continue supporting manufacturers and charging networks until March 2028.

stories.title: Battery supply chain vital for Indian EV goals
stories.summary: India is targeting 30 percent electric vehicle penetration by 2030. Success depends on domestic battery manufacturing and the development of a local supply chain. The transition requires the country to secure and process the materials necessary to power the growing fleet of electric vehicles.

stories.title: LICO Materials targets 10 GWh recycling capacity
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based LICO Materials recorded approximately 350 crore rupees in revenue for 2025-26 and targets 450-500 crore for 2026-27. The company currently operates 4 GWh of processing capacity for end-of-life lithium-ion batteries, aiming to expand its role in the electric-vehicle supply chain.

stories.title: Financing remains hurdle for inclusive EV adoption
stories.summary: India sold over 1.28 million electric two-wheelers in 2025, accounting for 6.3 percent of the market. Experts suggest that the next phase of adoption requires more than vehicle availability, as access to financing remains a critical factor for inclusive growth in the electric mobility sector.

Gurugram-based Delhivery, India's largest fully integrated logistics provider, has partnered with Tata Motors, Euler Mot
BYD launches Denza luxury EV brand in India
stories.summary: BYD has introduced its luxury Denza brand to the Indian market, positioning the D9 SUV and Z9 GT performance EV against established rivals like Mercedes-Benz and Toyota. The move comes despite high import tariffs and investment restrictions. Luxury is now available for those who can afford the entry fee.

stories.title: Denza Z9 GT launched in India
stories.summary: The Denza Z9 GT has arrived in India with a price tag of 1.57 crore rupees. The shooting brake model features leather upholstery, multiple wireless chargers, and a claimed range of 670 km. It joins the brand's initial lineup as a premium option for local drivers.

stories.title: Eternal reconsiders 2030 electric fleet target
stories.summary: The parent company of Zomato and Blinkit is revising its 2030 goal for a fully electric delivery fleet. The company cited the need to assess vehicle availability and infrastructure as the delivery economy outpaces current charging and policy systems. Deadlines are occasionally subject to reality.

stories.title: Eternal revises electric delivery fleet timeline
stories.summary: Eternal is reassessing its 2030 target for an all-electric delivery fleet, acknowledging the goal may not be feasible given the current scale of its operations. The company is now evaluating vehicle accessibility and government policy to set a new date. Ambition has met the logistics of scale.

stories.title: Zomato, Blinkit parent Eternal may push back 100% EV delivery fleet target - ET Auto
Ashok Leyland Q2 FY27 profit up 11% to ₹843 crore - ET Auto
Ashok Leyland Q2 profit
Mahindra reorganises automotive leadership
stories.summary: Mahindra is redrawing its automotive reporting lines effective April 1, 2027. Under President R Velusamy, Shuchi Suri will oversee vehicle sales, electric SUV marketing, and charging infrastructure. The company is shifting its internal structure as it prepares for future operations.

stories.title: Electric auto rickshaws reshape India’s roads | The Straits Times - newspaper - Magzter
Green SM electric taxi service expands to Bengaluru and Chennai
stories.summary: Vietnamese operator Green SM is expanding its all-electric taxi service to Bengaluru and Chennai after securing regulatory approval. The Vingroup-backed company is increasing its presence in the Indian ride-hailing market, adding more competition to the urban mobility sector.

stories.title: NLEX expands electric vehicle charging network
stories.summary: NLEX Corporation has increased its charging infrastructure, with six service stops now offering 20 charging points across its expressway network. The facilities provide power ratings from 22 kW to 240 kW to accommodate the growing number of electric vehicles traveling between Metro Manila and Central Luzon.

stories.title: Enfield resident proposes public charging stations
stories.summary: An Enfield resident is applying for a state grant to install two public-access electric vehicle charging stations at her home. The project aims to utilize the New Hampshire Recharge the Adventure program to cover costs. The application deadline is November 15.

stories.title: Three siblings killed in Sitapur road accident
stories.summary: Three siblings were killed early Sunday morning after being struck by a pickup vehicle and a tractor-trailer in Sitapur district. The victims were traveling by motorcycle when the accident occurred amid poor visibility. Local authorities are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Five injured in Gujarat vehicle collision
stories.summary: Five people were injured after a container truck struck a BSF vehicle, causing a tractor-trolley to overturn on a bridge in Banaskantha district. The BSF personnel were traveling from the Nadabet border when the collision occurred. The tractor-trolley narrowly avoided falling into the river.

stories.title: Sunil Mutha Elevated to Chief Executive Officer at ACMA India - https://hrtoday.in/
Amit Srivastava Appointed Chief Executive Officer to SSD & ASEAN Business at Minda Corporation Limited - https://hrtoday
Warburg Pincus to acquire stake in Pricol unit
stories.summary: Private equity firm Warburg Pincus will pay Rs 1,633.07 crore for a 38.51 percent stake in a new unit of Pricol Ltd. The deal follows a planned demerger of the company's driver information and connected vehicle business. The transaction remains subject to regulatory and demerger approvals.

stories.title: Warburg Pincus to acquire 38.51%promoter stake in Pricol Autotech after proposed demerger - ET Auto
Motherson eyes bigger India play with global technologies amid auto sector shift - ET Auto
Motherson targets USD 108 billion revenue by 2030
stories.summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd aims to reach USD 108 billion in revenue by 2030. The company plans to leverage technologies acquired through global expansion to meet rising demand for advanced automotive solutions in India. The strategy focuses on shifting emission norms and higher product standards.

stories.title: VE Commercial Vehicles focuses on fundamentals
stories.summary: VE Commercial Vehicles is prioritizing fuel efficiency, uptime, and productivity as it prepares for industry expansion. Despite market interest in software-defined vehicles and automation, the company maintains that technology is only valuable when it strengthens the core performance metrics that customers value most in commercial transport.

stories.title: Bosch and TSF Group form joint venture for air systems
stories.summary: Bosch and the TSF Group have launched a 50:50 joint venture to develop electronically controlled air systems for commercial vehicles. The partnership aims to integrate software into pneumatic technologies like braking and suspension. Software is increasingly being tasked with managing the air.

stories.title: Rubber market growth expected through 2035
stories.summary: The global polybutadiene rubber market is projected to grow through 2035, driven by tyre manufacturing and industrial polymer use. Asia-Pacific remains the central consumption hub for the industry. Supply chains are expected to remain anchored in major Asian industrial centres to support global production volumes.

stories.title: Plastics and polymers market enters 2026 with new focus
stories.summary: The global plastics, polymers, and elastomers market enters 2026 facing regulatory pressure and volatile feedstock costs. According to IndexBox, the sector is shifting toward more disciplined procurement and a regionally diversified supply architecture. The market remains a foundational segment of the industrial economy.

stories.title: In a Large Used-Car Market, CarMax and Carvana Clash Over How Americans Buy - WSJ
US dealerships resist shift to direct sales
stories.summary: Direct-to-consumer vehicle sales are gaining traction in the US, though 28 states still restrict or ban the practice. Dealerships remain concerned that EV companies and potential new entrants will bypass the traditional franchise model. The four-quadrant negotiation process is currently facing a change in geography.

stories.title: Indian car buyers shift to online research
stories.summary: Automobile dealers in India are rethinking customer engagement as buyers increasingly arrive at showrooms with pre-researched information. The shift toward online comparison is forcing dealers to prioritize convenience and trust over traditional showroom-based sales tactics. The buying journey is now largely happening before the visit.

stories.title: Hertz to close all physical car sales locations
stories.summary: Hertz will close its remaining physical retail stores to focus on its online car sales strategy. The company says the move is intended to meet customers where they want to shop. The retail car sales strategy has evolved over the past year.

stories.title: The history of Browns of Hereford
stories.summary: Founded in the 1920s as a cycle and motorcycle repair shop, Browns of Hereford grew to represent major automotive brands before eventually closing. The family business operated for decades in the local motor trade, marking its 50th anniversary in 1974 before fading into history.

stories.title: Dealer evaluates non-stock Corvette pricing
stories.summary: YouTuber and car dealer George Saliba has reviewed a second-hand Chevrolet Corvette GS to determine if the seller's asking price is realistic. The dealer noted that the vehicle contained non-stock parts, which the seller expected to be valued at a premium. The market value remains under review.

stories.title: Buyer uses email to challenge dealership pricing
stories.summary: A car buyer has adopted a method of emailing multiple dealerships within an hour's drive to secure lower prices. The approach is intended to bypass standard sales tactics and bottom-line figures. The process of buying a new car has been described by the buyer as excruciating.

stories.title: Auto shop customer questions $900 parts quote
stories.summary: A TikTok user recently questioned a $900 repair shop quote for parts he found available for under $200. The customer expressed confusion regarding the 4X markup on the components. Repair shops typically prefer to supply their own parts.

stories.title: Mechanic links repeat tows to aftermarket parts
stories.summary: A mechanic reports towing the same vehicle three times due to issues with Dorman auto parts. While cheaper components can save money on minor repairs like plastic clips, the mechanic notes that opting for the lowest price often necessitates further repairs down the line.

stories.title: Challenger SRT Demon 170 sold with 25 miles
stories.summary: The 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon 170 marked the end of the seventh-generation muscle car era before Stellantis discontinued the model and its HEMI engine. One owner recently sold their unit to a dealer with only 25 miles on the odometer.

stories.title: Mahindra Finance to shift focus from vehicle loans
stories.summary: Mahindra Finance plans to reduce its reliance on vehicle financing by expanding into affordable housing and secured lending for small enterprises. The company is targeting 16 to 18 percent growth in assets under management through fiscal year 2031.

stories.title: Court rules against using recovery agents for vehicle repossession
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has ruled that finance firms cannot use recovery agents to seize vehicles by force. The court stated that contractual repossession rights must be enforced through civil courts or arbitrators rather than by arming private parties with the coercive authority of the state.

stories.title: RBI maintains income-repayment ratio rules for MFIs
Form 4 Asbury Automotive Group Inc: Wendy Reynolds-Dobbs (SVP & CHRO) For: 14 September - Investing.com Nigeria
Sonic Automotive reports record quarterly revenue
stories.summary: Sonic Automotive reported record quarterly revenues of $4 billion on its October 2026 earnings call. Management attributed the performance to pricing discipline that preserved front-end vehicle margins despite normalized supply and choppy consumer demand. The company continues to prioritize operating discipline over chasing sales volume.

stories.title: Group 1 Automotive acquires Hennessey dealerships
stories.summary: Group 1 Automotive announced the acquisition of Hennessey Automotive Companies alongside a plan to sell underperforming locations. The retailer aims to improve margins by swapping lower-margin dealerships for high-volume luxury sites. Controlling operating costs remains the company's primary strategy for navigating auto cycle volatility.

stories.title: House of Abhinandan Lodha prepays HDFC Capital loan
stories.summary: Real estate firm The House of Abhinandan Lodha has prepaid a 1,100 crore rupee loan to HDFC Capital. The funds were originally raised to develop housing projects consisting mainly of plots. The company stated the payment was made before the due date to provide an exit for the investor.

stories.title: Banks increase lending rates to protect margins
stories.summary: At least five major banks have raised lending rates by up to 25 basis points following the Reserve Bank of India's recent rate signals. The hikes aim to protect margins as banks face rising deposit costs and high carrying costs for funds raised under the dollar swap scheme.

stories.title: SoftBank reduces stake in Meesho
stories.summary: SoftBank has sold a 1.65 percent stake in e-commerce firm Meesho for 1,885 crore rupees. The transaction, executed through an affiliate on the National Stock Exchange, reduces SoftBank's holding in the company to 5.19 percent. Domestic and foreign institutional investors participated in the sale.

stories.title: Nippon India Small Cap Fund reshuffles portfolio
stories.summary: Nippon India Small Cap Fund, which manages 76,903 crore rupees, added eight stocks and exited four in October 2026. New additions include large-cap stocks such as ITC and Bank of Baroda. The fund currently holds 260 stocks in its portfolio.

stories.title: Ola Electric market share declines
stories.summary: Ola Electric's share of the Indian electric two-wheeler market fell to 5.4 percent in March 2026 from 22.1 percent in April 2025. While the company led the segment in fiscal year 2025, competitors including Bajaj Auto and TVS Motor have since increased their market presence.

stories.title: JSW Motors partners with AWS to host connected-car data in India - HT Auto
JSW Motors partners with AWS to host connected-car data in India - Team-BHP
Autonomous vehicle demonstrations to begin in Gwangju
stories.summary: Autonomous vehicle demonstration runs are scheduled to begin in Gwangju on November 30. The project will initially utilize outlying roads before expanding to side streets. An integrated operations office will open on November 17 to support the deployment of 120 vehicles by the end of the year.

stories.title: Gwangju designated as autonomous driving testbed
stories.summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced that Gwangju will serve as South Korea's first citywide autonomous driving test environment. Safety checks are currently underway for the 120 vehicles expected to begin full-scale operations by the end of November.

stories.title: AutoMobility LA to focus on autonomous governance
stories.summary: AutoMobility LA will open its November 19 industry preview with a focus on the governance and technical deployment of autonomous systems. A panel featuring National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Administrator Jonathan Morrison will address federal regulatory frameworks, public safety integration and commercial scaling requirements for the industry.

stories.title: SANY deploys autonomous haul trucks in Tibet
stories.summary: SANY has deployed 60 of its 70-tonne battery electric haul trucks at the Zhibula Copper Mine in Tibet. The mine operates at 17,700 feet, where extreme weather and low oxygen levels make finding human operators difficult. The trucks are intended to manage the conditions without needing to breathe.

stories.title: Automakers seek single interface for tolling
stories.summary: Automakers are pitching the idea of replacing windshield toll transponders with direct vehicle-based interfaces. The North Carolina Turnpike Authority notes that while the technology is ready, the industry faces a hurdle: dozens of tolling agencies each require a different interface. The car is ready, but the road is not.

stories.title: Over-the-air updates explained
stories.summary: Modern vehicles now rely on dozens of computers to manage features ranging from infotainment to driver assistance. Over-the-air updates allow manufacturers to deliver software wirelessly to vehicles, a process introduced by Tesla in 2012. Cars are increasingly becoming machines that require regular digital maintenance to function as intended.

stories.title: Auto industry cools on monetizing vehicle data
stories.summary: A new survey suggests interest in monetizing vehicle data is declining across the automotive industry. Automakers cite regulatory hurdles and customer backlash as primary reasons for the shift. The industry is now refocusing its efforts on improving advanced driver assistance systems instead of selling owner information.

stories.title: How auto trade policy could change after Democrats’ midterm wins - Automotive News
Canadian auto sector divided on tariff strategy
stories.summary: Canada's auto manufacturers are split on how to approach trade negotiations with the United States. The Detroit Three favor a quick tariff deal to stabilize operations, while Honda and Toyota prefer a tradeable import credit system to avoid locking in uncompetitive tariff levels for vehicles built in Canada.

stories.title: BYD receives import relief in India
stories.summary: BYD has cleared a regulatory hurdle in India as three of its models received homologation from the country's testing authority. The approval removes an annual cap of 2,500 imported units per model. The company is now looking to expand its presence in the local electric vehicle market.

stories.title: Infrastructure gaps hinder EV adoption
stories.summary: While electric vehicle adoption is a policy goal, approximately 40 percent of UK households lack off-street parking, rising to 60 percent in urban areas. Residents without private driveways remain dependent on public charging infrastructure, which is currently subject to local council planning policies and ongoing implementation delays.

stories.title: COMMENTARY: Carney Government Relocates EV Mandate to Regulatory Witness Protection - EnergyNow
COMMENTARY: Canada’s EV Dreams Remain at Odds With Reality - EnergyNow
FTC settles with Stream Auto Outlet
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission reached an agreement with Stream Auto Outlet regarding deceptive vehicle pricing. Meanwhile, Tennessee regulators denied Scout Motors a dealer license for direct sales, and the average new vehicle price reached a record $51,109 in October. Hertz is shifting its sales strategy to online only.

stories.title: Investors urge Nvidia to keep succession options open
stories.summary: Altimeter Capital and Atreides Management have urged Nvidia's board to keep the possibility of Jensen Huang returning as CEO open. The investors requested a slow succession process following Huang's sudden resignation, citing the massive uncertainty associated with the leadership change at the company.

stories.title: CTR-JK Tyre FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship Round 2 concludes - evo India
FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship results
stories.summary: The second round of the FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship 2026 opened with close finishes at the Kari Motor Speedway. Augustine Boby won the F1300 Novice Cup by 0.032 seconds, while Mehul Agarwal and Deepak Ravikumar secured victories in their respective categories following late-race overtakes.

stories.title: Close finishes mark INRC racing round
stories.summary: Day one of the second round of the Indian National Car Racing Championship featured multiple last-lap battles and narrow margins. Mehul Agarwal won the LGB Formula 4 race by 0.237 seconds, while Augustine Boby claimed the F1300 Novice Cup with a 0.032-second lead over his nearest competitor.

stories.title: India's Atiqa Mir, 11, Earns Prestigious FIA Rising Stars Selection - NDTV Sports
Atiqa Mir joins FIA women driver program
stories.summary: Atiqa Mir is the only Indian driver selected for the FIA Girls On Track Rising Stars program for 2026. The 12-14 age category initiative aims to develop young women at the grassroots level. Mir was chosen following her performances in the Champions of the Future Academy championship.

stories.title: Atiqa Mir selected for FIA development program
stories.summary: Atiqa Mir is the only Indian driver named in the junior category for the 2026 FIA Girls On Track Rising Stars program. The initiative, launched in 2018, aims to promote young women in motorsport. Mir was selected after competing in the FIA Karting World Championship.

stories.title: Atiqa Mir named to FIA Rising Stars program
stories.summary: Atiqa Mir has been selected as the sole Indian participant in the 2026 FIA Girls On Track Rising Stars junior category. The FIA-backed initiative aims to develop young female talent. Mir earned her spot following performances in the Champions of the Future Academy and FIA Karting World Championship.

stories.title: Sri Lankan duo finds success in Indian racing
stories.summary: Kaveen Rajapaksa and Aadam Junaid secured places on the rookies podium during the second round of the CTR-JK Tyre FMSCI Indian National Car Racing Championship. The pair competed in the Levitas Cup, where Rajapaksa took the top step of the podium.

stories.title: Formula E confirms 2027 season line-up
stories.summary: The 2026-27 Formula E season will introduce the Gen4 single-seater and a new weekend format. Testing begins at Circuito del Jarama on 16 November, with the campaign starting in Mexico in January. Nissan has confirmed Oliver Rowland and Zane Maloney as its drivers for the new season.

stories.title: Ohvale motorcycles offer training for young riders
stories.summary: Italian brand Ohvale produces purpose-built mini motorcycles for training and racing. While not road legal, the bikes are used by MotoGP riders to hone skills at go-kart circuits. The Indian line-up includes the GP-0 in 110cc and 160cc versions, alongside the GP-2 190 model.

stories.title: India targets fossil fuel exit by 2040
stories.summary: India aims to transition away from fossil fuels by 2040 to improve energy security and public health. The shift requires an integrated clean mobility ecosystem to reduce dependence on crude oil imports. Transport remains one of the country's largest fossil fuel users.

stories.title: EV transition faces retrofit challenge
stories.summary: Electric vehicle penetration reached 8.5 percent in fiscal year 2025-26, falling short of the 30 percent target for 2030. With over 33 crore petrol and diesel vehicles on the road, some suggest Auto LPG retrofitting as a faster method to reduce emissions from the existing fleet.

stories.title: GM sustainability chief leads industry ranking
stories.summary: General Motors Chief Sustainability Officer Cassandra Garber holds the top spot in Sustainability Magazine's 2026 list of automotive leaders. Volkswagen's Dirk Voeste and Toyota's Yumi Otsuka follow. The list ranks executives based on their influence over fleet carbon rules, battery due diligence and circularity strategies.

stories.title: Service stations install solar to meet EV demand
stories.summary: UK service station operators are installing solar farms to manage electricity demand from electric vehicles. Grid connection delays have forced operators to deploy marshals to manage queues during peak travel times. The industry says expansion is currently failing to keep pace with rising EV sales.

stories.title: Report suggests US EV sales growth slowing
stories.summary: A BloombergNEF report projects that only 17 percent of U.S. car sales will have a plug by 2030. Previous industry estimates were significantly higher. The report cites policy changes as a primary factor in the shift away from earlier growth projections for electric vehicles.

stories.title: What Your Next Electric Car Could Learn From Formula E GEN4 - Forbes
Morocco faces automotive decarbonisation challenge
stories.summary: Morocco is seeking to improve the energy efficiency of its automotive sector to remain competitive with European markets. The country faces challenges from an ageing vehicle fleet and a lack of regulatory frameworks. Transport currently accounts for 28 percent of the nation's emissions.

stories.title: Silverlake Automotive Recycling wins industry award
stories.summary: Silverlake Automotive Recycling was named Green Parts Supplier of the Year 2026 at the Auto Body Professionals Night of Knights Awards. The company supplies recycled vehicle parts to the body repair industry. The award winner is determined by votes from bodyshops.

stories.title: China auto industry profit margins decline
stories.summary: Profit margins in China's automotive sector fell to 3.6 percent in 2026, down from 9 percent in 2014. Domestic passenger vehicle sales dropped 27.1 percent in October, marking 12 consecutive months of contraction. Consumers are reportedly postponing major purchases amid economic uncertainty.

stories.title: Chinese automotive profits hit 12-year low
stories.summary: Profit margins for China's automotive industry fell to 3.6 percent in the first eight months of 2026. This marks the 12th consecutive year of decline. The sector is currently struggling with excessive production capacity, weakening domestic demand and intense price competition.

stories.title: Mediterranean ports expand as Chinese car imports surge
stories.summary: Mediterranean ports are expanding capacity as Chinese vehicle imports into Europe rise 38 percent. The shift overtakes Japanese market share and forces a transformation of existing automotive logistics networks. The geography of car delivery is moving south to accommodate the change.

stories.title: Chinese automakers struggle for market share in Vietnam
stories.summary: Sixteen Chinese passenger car brands now operate in Vietnam, yet they accounted for only 3.6 percent of the 412,000 vehicles sold in the first nine months of 2026. BYD and Geely saw sales growth, but the influx of brands has not yet translated into broad market dominance.

stories.title: Pakistan small-car sales surge amid fuel price increases
stories.summary: Sales of vehicles with engines below 1,000cc rose 118 percent in October to 11,885 units, according to PAMA data. Suzuki Alto sales led the shift with a 130 percent increase. Consumers are opting for smaller engines as fuel costs rise following the outbreak of the Iran war.
